description: Source code for handling MAC binding web configuration parameters, including functions for converting, destroying, and processing message-packed data structures related to MAC address bindings.

methods.name: process_macdocparams
methods.description: Converts a msgpack map into a macdoc_t structure by extracting 'Yiaddr' and 'Chaddr' string fields.

methods.name: process_macbindingdoc
methods.description: Processes a msgpack array into a macbindingdoc_t structure, including sub-document name, version, transaction ID, and entries.
